title: I made an app
author: Outrageous_Breath957
selftext: Hi everyone! I’m new to investing and built \*\*T-Rex Market Radar\*\* to make charts, indicators, ETFs, swing setups, options data, and recent market news easier for beginners to understand. It only organizes and analyzes available data—it is \*\*not financial advice or a buy/sell signal\*\*, and the information may be delayed or incomplete. Please research each company, read current news, and verify everything before investing. I thought other beginners might find it useful too, so feel free to try it and share any suggestions or bugs you notice! I'm not promoting myself just thought if someone might be intrested. That's all.

comments.author: justBawesome
comments.body: I did build something similar. But it included my portfolio as well to track it and then use the current holdings to analyze the potential opportunity for selling cc or csp
